g0.rationale: The directions state one mode: wash with shampoo, then work the Kur into wet, washed hair with emphasis on the ends, leave 3-5 minutes, and rinse thoroughly. All three G0 conjuncts are clear and the placement matches P5. Identity is resolved to one SKU: Frizz Ease Wunder-Reparatur Tiefenwirksame Wunder-Kur, 250 ml, Müller PPN3176126, with a dated direct-extraction INCI. There is no GTIN; the Müller PPN serves as the reliable identifier.

g0.notes: Replaces the earlier insufficient-information stop. GTIN is still absent; identity rests on the retailer PPN.

tailMarker.note: The earliest tail-class species is the trace chelator TETRASODIUM GLUTAMATE DIACETATE @10. MALIC ACID @11 and SODIUM HYDROXIDE @15 are not marker-eligible. The preservatives (MCI/MIT @20-21), FRAGRANCE @22 and the allergen HEXYL CINNAMAL @23 follow it in a consistent order, and the chelator is not printed beneath the preservatives anywhere else on the capture, so the E2 third limb does not fire. The base (CETEARYL ALCOHOL @2, DIMETHICONE @3, BEHENTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE @4, BEHENYL ALCOHOL @5, amodimethicone @7, DIMETHICONOL @8) outranks the marker. All three plant oils (COCONUT @12, OLIVE @13, CASTOR @14) sit below it and are read as sub-1% secondary lipids. tail_index-1 = PEG-45M @9, which is not load-bearing in any field.

conditioning_level.rationale: Only S2 fires: CETEARYL ALCOHOL at rank 2, with BEHENYL ALCOHOL @5 also above the tail. S1 fails, because BEHENTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE @4 is the only cationic on the list. S3 fails: there is no non-fatty-alcohol lipid above the tail, and silicones are R2, not R4. One signal gives moderate.

weight_potential.rationale: High is unavailable: no R4b lipid sits above the chelator marker @10. Low fails conjunct 2: an occlusive silicone stack sits above the tail (DIMETHICONE @3, BIS(C13-15 ALKOXY) PG-AMODIMETHICONE @7, DIMETHICONOL @8, including a dimethicone/dimethiconol pair). Conjuncts 1 and 3 hold (no R4b above the marker, BTAC the only cationic on the full list). No boundary species is load-bearing.
counterSignals: three R4b-class oils (coconut, olive, castor) sit just below the marker; under a strict §3.1.1 reading they would be read on their own merits (see review note)

care_direction.rationale: There is no R5 species, so no protein leg; ceramides are tail-only and are not R5. Balanced reading (b) was tested and fails on clause 4. Clauses 1-3 hold: no protein, a silicone system of three distinct R2 species above the tail (E9), and no humectant pair or S3 lipid stack above the tail. But the system cannot be established without AMODIMETHICONE @7 or DIMETHICONOL @8, and both rank below the candidate humectant DIPROPYLENE GLYCOL @6. So the value falls to the moisture default. The moisture-versus-neither_dominant call hinges on one glycol's rank and on whether that glycol is a humectant or a solvent, so confidence is stepped down to low and the field routed to review (§9.3 reading-(b) confidence rule).
evidenceSignals: base: CETEARYL ALCOHOL @2, BTAC @4, BEHENYL ALCOHOL @5
counterSignals: silicone system DIMETHICONE @3 / amodimethicone @7 / DIMETHICONOL @8 is film-led and nearly satisfies reading (b)
subordinate tail legs: COCONUT OIL @12, OLIVE OIL @13, CASTOR OIL @14

repair_support_level.rationale: There is no protein, peptide or keratin film route and no named bond token. CERAMIDE NG @17 and CERAMIDE NP @18 are tail-only and are explicit non-upgraders. 'Wunder-Reparatur' naming is E0.
counterSignals: repair positioning with no formula route (claim mismatch)

primary_focus.rationale: Repair, curl, colour and moisture fail (no R5 or bond route; one above-tail humectant). Shine fails criterion 3: there is no Gloss/Glanz/Laminierung positioning, and the film is the smoothing film (criterion 2). Smoothing clears step 6, because the architecture extends materially beyond the ordinary R1 base through a distinct three-species silicone route above the tail (DIMETHICONE @3, amodimethicone @7, DIMETHICONOL @8). 'Frizz Ease' anti-frizz positioning corroborates it but did not create the route. focus_care_verdict: not_applicable; claim_role: corroborating.
counterSignals: competing detangling lost: slip is baseline and no distinct combability route
competing shine lost: no gloss claim, film already counted as smoothing (§6 rule 2)

secondary_focus.rationale: No second endpoint clears. Shine fails corroboration and would reuse the smoothing film. Moisture fails criterion 1.
